10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:18409b2d-fad2-45.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you an experienced business development professional who instinctively spots gaps in strategy and recognizes the nuances of building AI-powered products? Do you have 8 to 20 hours per week available alongside your main job or freelance work? Join us in shaping how AI understands and applies business development expertise at scale. About the Role 10x Team connects expert freelancers with leading AI labs building next-generation models. We are seeking knowledgeable business development specialists based in the EU or UK to enhance the accuracy, depth, and real-world relevance of AI-powered business and sales systems. What You Will Do - Review and refine AI-generated outputs related to business development, lead generation, client relationship management, and commercial strategy - Evaluate AI responses for practical relevance, clarity, and compliance with real-world standards - Draft realistic business development scenarios based on your direct professional experience - Create scenario variations from different perspectives (e.g. business development manager, client, stakeholder, or executive) - Identify gaps, oversights, or weak logic in AI-generated business content In simple terms: You will assess and improve AI-generated business development content, ensuring it reflects authentic commercial reasoning, strategic approaches, and practical sales processes. Rather than conducting traditional business development tasks, you’ll apply your expertise to help AI systems understand and reason about commercial practices at scale. Who You Are - A senior-level business development specialist or manager with significant professional experience within the EU or UK - Experienced in building, executing, and evaluating commercial strategies - Skilled at reviewing business processes, client interactions, and sales strategies - Comfortable working independently and providing structured, critical feedback - Available for 8–20 hours per week, with prompt availability Why Join? - Flexible, fully remote freelance work that fits your current commitments - Apply your business development expertise in an evolving, high-impact AI environment - Directly contribute to the development of advanced AI-powered business tools - Free access to our in-house AI Academy to further develop your AI skillset - Clear onboarding, structured tasks, and ongoing opportunities for collaboration How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Join us to help shape the business development expertise of the world’s most advanced AI models! ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. 1840company-1840-company:lever:f74cddd3-.description: A fast-growing US-based company is expanding internationally and launching its first on-site sales hub in Medellín. The company is hiring Senior Sales Executive who will play a key role in building and scaling outbound sales efforts from the ground up. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role designed for experienced outbound professionals who are comfortable operating in high-activity environments and engaging senior decision-makers across traditional industries. This role offers high earning potential, performance-based compensation accelerators, and the opportunity to meaningfully impact a scaling team.
responsibilities: Execute high-volume outbound calling to generate qualified sales opportunities.
Engage C-level and VP-level decision-makers across industries such as manufacturing, staffing, healthcare, finance, logistics.
Manage first-touch outreach through outbound calls and targeted follow-up emails.
Maintain accurate CRM records and ensure consistent follow-up and activity tracking.
Collaborate with Growth, Revenue, and Operations teams to support pipeline development.
qualifications: 3 to 6+ years of experience as a BDR or SDR in outbound, high-volume sales environments.
Demonstrated success booking meetings with senior executives, preferably in non-tech or traditional industries.
Advanced English proficiency, both spoken and written.
Strong work ethic, consistency, and resilience in outbound sales.
Track record of meeting or exceeding quotas, supported by references.
Experience selling into the US market.

The company and its service providers collectively serve over 95,000 businesses and process over $135B in annual payroll. jobgether-jobgether:lever:bf3b1e00-b291-.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Supplier Growth
jobgether-jobgether:lever:bf3b1e00-b291-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive, Supplier Growth based in the United States. This is a strategic, enterprise-focused sales role centered on growing supplier adoption of B2B payment and accounts receivable solutions. You will engage senior finance leaders, including CFOs, Treasurers, Controllers, and Accounts Receivable executives. The role combines outbound prospecting, consultative selling, relationship building, and data-driven pipeline development. You will manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from lead generation through booking and implementation. Success requires an entrepreneurial mindset, strong analytical abilities, and the confidence to influence enterprise decision-makers. You’ll join a high-performing, fast-paced fintech sales environment focused on scalable growth and measurable customer value. The position is remote within the U.S., with up to 25% travel potentially required. Build and manage a strong enterprise sales pipeline by sourcing, developing, and converting new opportunities through outbound activity, internal networks, external relationships, and data analysis. Sell B2B payment and accounts receivable solutions to enterprise suppliers, engaging finance, treasury, accounts receivable, and other senior business stakeholders. Own the full sales cycle from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, booking, implementation coordination, and ongoing relationship development. Develop strategic account plans that identify both immediate opportunities and longer-term solution-selling potential, while expanding relationships across multiple contacts within each customer organization. Act as a trusted advisor to customers by understanding their accounts receivable and payment processes, identifying challenges, and positioning solutions that create measurable business value. Use customer insights, sales data, and market information to identify needs, refine sales strategies, improve funnel performance, and support consistent revenue growth. Maintain accurate CRM documentation, forecasts, account plans, and internal communications in line with established sales practices. Build strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders, professionally representing the organization and creating sustained customer engagement. Navigate complex sales environments involving multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and varied customer needs while maintaining urgency and focus on business objectives. Contribute to a high-performing sales culture through collaboration, knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and a commitment to exceeding customer expectations. Requirements: 5+ years of professional sales experience, ideally involving SaaS, treasury, payments, accounts receivable, or other financial technology solutions sold to enterprise organizations. Proven experience selling to senior enterprise decision-makers, particularly within CFO, Treasurer, Controller, Accounts Receivable, treasury, or corporate finance functions. Demonstrated success managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles, including customer implementation and relationship management. Strong analytical and consultative selling skills, with the ability to use data and customer interactions to uncover business needs and develop relevant solutions. Ability to design and execute creative customer adoption and sales strategies that improve performance and generate measurable financial results. Strong relationship-building, negotiation, consulting, and conflict-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders and organizations. Entrepreneurial, self-motivated, and results-oriented approach, combined with a strong ability to collaborate as part of a high-performing team. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate value clearly
